assessment.standardsDrift: No substantive drift found. Existing timeouts, package floors, test projects, mutators, zero retries and public APIs remain intact. ADR-0174 documents the partition-sizing change.
assessment.gateHonesty: The supplied exact-HEAD completion output remains red at 23/71 legs, including missing hosted mutation evidence and unfinished features. Diagnostic annotations explicitly identify partial evidence and cannot satisfy whole-run qualification.
assessment.architecture: The new record-command family and SHA-256 length helper remain internal pure-core modules. Command ordering and hash equations are preserved. No runtime dependencies or public API expansion were introduced.
assessment.planHealth: 58 rows versus 43 planned is approximately 1.35x, below the 1.5x trigger. Growth reflects explicit mutation recovery and prerequisite work. Subsequent milestones should budget for complete mutation execution and oversized-source recovery separately from harness orchestration.
